description: This spacious three-bedroom apartment is embraced by natural light and its huge windows offer the place stunning Parisian views. Our interior designer has used soft pastels and delicate paintings to create an elegant Parisian hideaway. Two bedrooms boast wide double beds, and the third, with two twin beds, is perfect for children. With the fully equipped kitchen, you will have the choice to either practice your French cuisine skills or try one of the many restaurants in the neighbourhood.The space76 sqm1st bedroom (1 double bed)1st ensuite bathroom (shower only)2nd bedroom (1 double bed)3rd bedroom (2 single beds)2nd bathroom (shower/toilet)1 separated toiletFinest linens, towels and toiletriesFully equipped kitchenNespresso machine with capsulesOther things to noteTo ensure a smooth and secure arrival, you will need to complete a brief online check-in process before your stay. It's quick, easy, and helps us prepare for your visit!
